Our Approach Curriculum Health Hub Health Hub Keeping Fit Nutrition Careers Join our Team Vacancies Employee of the month Parent Information Parent Hub Login Fees & Funding Testimonials FAQs Blogs, News & Spotlights at Jancett About Us Our ethos: Our ethos is based around the care for each individual child. Our passionate and caring team members join the profession of Childcare and the Jancett Community because of their love for children and the joy in watching them grow and develop through play, care, and education. This is perhaps best illustrated in our choice of logo – the simple tree: with its strong roots providing a solid foundation and its branches showing a strong connection to family and community, as it matures each season to grow and reach its full potential. We offer childcare for children from 3 months to 5 years, across our Community of Nurseries. Each of our Nursery settings provides specialist care for babies (our Baby Rooms); toddlers (our Family Rooms); and pre-school children (our Pre-school Rooms). Our Vision and Values: Where Children Come First – these four words run through everything we do, from the activities we provide to the policies we put into place. The children are always at the centre of every decision we make, no matter how big or how small. This is the very reason why many parents and staff chose us. Our community is a place where all children are valued and where they grow, succeed, and thrive because, before we make any decisions, we consider those 4 little words that are so very important, and this is why the Jancett Community is the best place for a child to be. Our Values are the steps that we undertake to put our Vision in to practice, we believe by adopting our values we will always be following our vision – Where Children Come First. –Quality – Ensuring children and parents receive a high quality service. Staff are trained and supported in their roles to help provide this service and continuously reflect on their work to implement positive changes. –Nurturing – Parents know that their children are safe, secure, and cared for, through a strong attachment with the staff. Our Approach Curriculum Health Hub Health Hub Keeping Fit Nutrition Careers Join our Team Vacancies Employee of the month Parent Information Parent Hub Login Fees & Funding Testimonials FAQs Blogs, News & Spotlights at Jancett Fees & Funding Jancett Childcare are committed to helping families access financial support available for early years education. We embrace childcare funding options, including Universal Credit, Enjoy benefits, Tax-Free Childcare, Childcare Vouchers and the 15- and 30-hours Entitlement Funding. This webpage explains the Entitlement funding and Fee Structure, including how the 15- and 30-hour government-funded places are applied across our nurseries. Our aim is to make funding as straightforward and transparent as possible. If you have any questions, our team is always happy to help [email protected] We’re Here to Help At Jancett Childcare, we understand that funding and fees can sometimes feel confusing, but you’re not alone. Our team is always happy to guide you through the process, explain your options, and help you make the most of your childcare entitlement. Whether you need support checking your eligibility, understanding your funding hours, or planning your childcare pattern, we’re here to make things simple and stress-free. Please don’t hesitate to contact us at [email protected] if you have any questions, we’re always happy to help you find the best option for your family. Full terms and conditions can be found in our Funding and Fee policy, this will be sent to you at the time of booking a viewing. Book a Viewing Eligibility and Key Information Eligibility depends on personal circumstances. Check yours at: Homepage | Best Start in Life Funding begins the term after your child turns 9 months, 2 years, or 3 years. 15 hours or 30 hours funding is offered for 38 weeks per year by the government. Funding does not include meals or additional services. You must apply for and reconfirm your code via your government portal.
